target.title: [AI-assisted] fix(android): polish home overview layout
target.body: ## What Problem This Solves The Android Home overview looked slightly uneven because its primary overview boxes, Talk entry, and recent-session rows did not reserve consistent vertical space. On device, that made the first screen feel a little cramped and less deliberate, even though the content and behavior were correct. ## Why This Change Was Made This is a focused visual polish pass in ShellScreen.kt, following maintainer direction for quick wins around visual box sizing and cleanup. It is not a redesign. It keeps the Home, Chat, and Settings flows intact while tightening the Home overview surface. The change: - gives the overview metric tiles a consistent minimum height - gives the Talk panel a steadier minimum height and padding rhythm - gives recent-session rows a clearer minimum tap target - normalizes local spacing, padding, and corner-radius values around the Home overview components ## User Impact Android users get a calmer and more consistent Home overview layout. The difference is intentionally subtle: content, colors, navigation, gateway behavior, chat behavior, and settings behavior stay the same, while the Home overview boxes and rows hold steadier dimensions. ## Evidence - git diff --check: passed. - :app:assemblePlayDebug --no-daemon: passed. - Before Home overview screenshot: - After Home overview screenshot: - Before video: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c3ff39c9-54b4-43fb-ba3c-822b4fd038c2 - After video: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6dd03dc0-b95a-4bbe-953a-83a0b01d2a71
